name: Steam
description: See Steam player status, two weeks of playtime, your game library, achievement progress and regional prices for your public wishlist in Persona. Access is read-only. The Hub encrypts your Steam Web API key.

steam_id.title: Steam player ID
steam_id.description: Enter your 17-digit SteamID64 or the vanity name from your Steam profile URL.

country_code.title: Store country or region
country_code.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country or region code for wishlist prices and currency. Defaults to US.

steam_api_key.title: Steam Web API key
steam_api_key.description: Get a key from your Steam Web API settings. The Hub encrypts it and sends it only to api.steampowered.com.
